September, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 D/L43 C.R.R.763 of 2023
19.09.2023
Bpg.
In Re: An application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure;
Dina Bhattacharya Versus State of West Bengal and another Mr. Biswanath Chatterjee Mr. Soham
Krishna Chatterjee Mr. Sobham Kumar Pathak.
...for the petitioner.
Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee, Ld.P.P. Mr. Pravas Bhattacharyya Mr. Mirza Firoj Ahmed Begg.
...for the State.

Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon Mr. Begg, learned advocate,
who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State.
His appointment may be regularised by the concerned authorities.
Petitioner has approached this Court for expeditious disposal of Lake Police Station Case No.58 of 2008 which is presently pending before the learned CJM, Alipore/trial court.

entities.text: Lake Police Station Case No.58 of 2008
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Records of the revisional application reflect that dates have been fixed for evidence.
However, the case is pending since the year 2008.
More than 15 years have passed since the case has commenced.
The allegations are under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

As the case is pending for more than 15 years, I direct that the learned trial court would fix at least one date in every 15 days so that the trial of the case can be taken to its logical conclusion within a reasonable period of time.

In case any witness is absent on the date so fixed, the learned trial court would communicate with the Officer-in-Charge of Lake Police Station so that the appearance of the witness is ensured on the date so fixed for trial.
No unnecessary adjournment should be granted to either of the parties.
